introduction: "Is it okay if souls are your friends?"Mi-ta, a singer-songwriter who can see souls.One day, she becomes friends with a group of four unique ghosts and forms the 'Ghost Band'.Taking on the role of vocalist, she discovers the joy of singing together in front of an audience for the first time in her life.As videos of Mi-ta and the Ghost Band's performance take social media by storm, and just as the stage of her dreams is finally within her reach, she faces a crisis due to massive sabotage by a major entertainment agency..."I want to sing with my friends."The stage of a fantasy K-pop band that will steal your heart this summer begins!
